verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB is positioned as a fully managed service, but it documents a BYOC deployment option that runs inside the customer's own AWS or Google Cloud account, where data 'never leaves your cloud or your hardware.' That is a vendor-run deployment in customer infrastructure, not a documented self-installable or self-operated core product. Missing for 10: a self-managed install or deployment guide, evidence that customers can operate the core without the vendor, clarity on on-prem/hardware support beyond the single 'your hardware' phrase, any open-source or downloadable distribution, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: or as BYOC inside your own AWS or Google Cloud account
